journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

articles.title_en: Climate change and the US wheat commodity market
articles.title_cn: 气候变化与美国小麦商品市场
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact on the workings of the wheat commodity market of increasing weather variability, one of the direct consequences of climate change. After finding strong evidence of an increase in the variance of weather and harvest for wheat in the US, we develop a structural time series model of the commodity market to investigate the sources and consequences of this increased variability. Exploiting this model, we devise a novel empirical procedure to analyze the impact on price and the potential adjustments of the speculative demand for inventories, as predicted by the rational storage theory. We find that speculation in the physical market for wheat at annual frequency adapted to the greater uncertainty about harvest stabilizing the market price.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了气候变化的一个直接后果——天气变率增加——对小麦商品市场运行的影响。在发现美国小麦天气和收成方差增加的有力证据后，我们开发了一个商品市场的结构时间序列模型，以调查这种增加变率的来源和后果。利用该模型，我们设计了一种新颖的实证程序，分析对价格的影响以及投机性库存需求的潜在调整，正如理性存储理论所预测的那样。我们发现，年度频率下小麦实物市场的投机行为适应了收成更大的不确定性，从而稳定了市场价格。

articles.title_en: Heterogeneous asset valuation in OTC markets and optimal inflation
articles.title_cn: 场外交易市场中的异质资产估值与最优通货膨胀
articles.abstract_en: Building on recent work in monetary theory and finance, we develop a framework where money serves a double liquidity role, namely, it serves as a medium of exchange in goods markets as well as asset markets. We argue that studying such a framework is not only more empirically relevant, but also gives rise to new, important economic insights regarding the effects of inflation on welfare and asset prices. The main result of the paper is that, contrary to conventional wisdom, in our model welfare can be increasing in inflation due to a new channel whereby higher inflation promotes beneficial trade in the secondary asset market.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于货币理论与金融学的最新研究，我们构建了一个框架，其中货币承担双重流动性角色，即作为商品市场以及资产市场的交换媒介。我们认为，研究这样的框架不仅更具实证相关性，而且能产生关于通货膨胀对福利和资产价格影响的新重要经济见解。本文的主要结果是，与传统观念相反，在我们的模型中，福利可能随通货膨胀而增加，这是因为一个新的渠道，即更高的通货膨胀促进了二级资产市场中的有益交易。

articles.title_en: Optimal fiscal and monetary policy with collateral constraints
articles.title_cn: 具有抵押品约束的最优财政与货币政策
articles.abstract_en: We study the Ramsey optimal fiscal and monetary policy in an economy where banks face collateral constraints. Inflation reduces the net worth of banks and tightens their collateral constraint by revaluing their nominal assets and liabilities. The optimal policy balances tax distortions with the costs of inflation on banks, thereby deviating from perfect tax smoothing. Our quantitative analysis reveals that inflation plays a much smaller role in financing fiscal needs in the optimal policy compared to existing literature. When considering price stickiness and long-term government debt, optimal inflation is modest and persistent, and the role of inflation in fiscal financing increases with the maturity of government debt.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在银行面临抵押品约束的经济中的拉姆齐最优财政与货币政策。通货膨胀通过重估银行的 nominal 资产和负债，降低了银行的净值并收紧其抵押品约束。最优政策在税收扭曲与通货膨胀对银行的成本之间取得平衡，从而偏离了完美的税收平滑。我们的定量分析表明，与现有文献相比，在最优政策中，通货膨胀在满足财政需求方面所起的作用要小得多。当考虑价格粘性和长期政府债务时，最优通货膨胀是温和且持久的，并且通货膨胀在财政融资中的作用随着政府债务期限的延长而增加。

articles.title_en: Black-box Bayesian inference for agent-based models
articles.title_cn: 基于智能体的模型的黑箱贝叶斯推断
articles.abstract_en: Simulation models, in particular agent-based models, are gaining popularity in economics and the social sciences. The considerable flexibility they offer, as well as their capacity to reproduce a variety of empirically observed behaviours of complex systems, give them broad appeal, and the increasing availability of cheap computing power has made their use feasible. Yet a widespread adoption in real-world modelling and decision-making scenarios has been hindered by the difficulty of performing parameter estimation for such models. In general, simulation models lack a tractable likelihood function, which precludes a straightforward application of standard statistical inference techniques. A number of recent works have sought to address this problem through the application of likelihood-free inference techniques, in which parameter estimates are determined by performing some form of comparison between the observed data and simulation output. However, these approaches are (a) founded on restrictive assumptions, and/or (b) typically require many hundreds of thousands of simulations. These qualities make them unsuitable for large-scale simulations in economics and the social sciences, and can cast doubt on the validity of these inference methods in such scenarios. In this paper, we investigate the efficacy of two classes of simulation-efficient black-box approximate Bayesian inference methods that have recently drawn significant attention within the probabilistic machine learning community: neural posterior estimation and neural density ratio estimation. We present a number of benchmarking experiments in which we demonstrate that neural network-based black-box methods provide state of the art parameter inference for economic simulation models, and crucially are compatible with generic multivariate or even non-Euclidean time-series data. In addition, we suggest appropriate assessment criteria for use in future benchmarking of approximate Bayesian inference procedures for simulation models in economics and the social sciences.
articles.abstract_cn: 仿真模型，特别是基于智能体的模型，在经济学和社会科学中越来越受欢迎。它们提供的相当大的灵活性，以及再现复杂系统各种经验观察行为的能力，使它们具有广泛的吸引力，并且廉价计算能力的日益普及使它们的使用变得可行。然而，在现实世界的建模和决策场景中广泛采用一直受到此类模型参数估计困难的阻碍。一般来说，仿真模型缺乏易处理的似然函数，这排除了标准统计推断技术的直接应用。最近的一些工作试图通过应用无似然推断技术来解决这个问题，其中参数估计是通过在观测数据和模拟输出之间进行某种形式的比较来确定的。然而，这些方法（a）建立在限制性假设之上，和/或（b）通常需要数十万次模拟。这些特性使它们不适合经济学和社会科学中的大规模模拟，并可能对这些推断方法在此类场景中的有效性产生怀疑。在本文中，我们研究了两类模拟高效的近似贝叶斯推断方法的有效性，这些方法最近在概率机器学习社区中引起了极大关注：神经后验估计和神经密度比估计。我们提出了一些基准测试实验，在这些实验中，我们证明了基于神经网络的黑色箱方法为经济仿真模型提供了最先进的参数推断，并且关键的是，它们与通用的多元甚至非欧几里得时间序列数据兼容。此外，我们建议在经济学和社会科学中未来对仿真模型的近似贝叶斯推断程序进行基准测试时使用适当的评估标准。

articles.title_en: Financial decisions involving credit default swaps over the business cycle
articles.title_cn: 信用违约互换涉及商业周期的金融决策
articles.abstract_en: We propose a modeling approach to disentangle how idiosyncratic and aggregate shocks shape the impact of credit default swaps (CDSs) on CDS firms' financial decisions. Our relatively parsimonious model highlights a novel mechanism contributing to CDS procyclicality. We show that CDSs postpone debt renegotiation and risk-taking investment. CDS firms have higher leverage ratios than non-CDS firms. CDS firms' leverage and credit spreads are counter-cyclical. CDS firms' debt overhang is less significant than non-CDS firms. CDSs can increase or decrease CDS firms' value, depending on macroeconomic conditions, idiosyncratic risk, and borrowers' bargaining power. Empirical studies verify some model predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一种建模方法，以厘清特质冲击和总体冲击如何塑造信用违约互换（CDS）对CDS公司金融决策的影响。我们相对简约的模型突显了一种促成CDS顺周期性的新机制。我们表明，CDS推迟了债务重新谈判和风险承担投资。CDS公司的杠杆率高于非CDS公司。CDS公司的杠杆率和信用利差是逆周期的。CDS公司的债务积压不如非CDS公司显著。CDS可以增加或减少CDS公司的价值，这取决于宏观经济状况、特质风险和借款人的议价能力。实证研究验证了模型的一些预测。

articles.title_en: Heteroskedastic proxy vector autoregressions: An identification-robust test for time-varying impulse responses in the presence of multiple proxies
articles.title_cn: 异方差代理向量自回归：存在多个代理时对时变脉冲响应的识别稳健检验
articles.abstract_en: We propose a test for time-varying impulse responses in heteroskedastic structural vector autoregressions that can be used when the shocks are identified by external proxy variables as a group but not necessarily individually. The test is robust to the identification scheme for identifying the shocks individually and can be used even if the shocks are not identified individually. The asymptotic analysis is supported by small sample simulations which show good properties of the test. An investigation of the impact of productivity shocks in a small macroeconomic model for the U.S. illustrates the importance of the issue for empirical work.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种在异方差结构向量自回归中检验时变脉冲响应的方法，该方法适用于冲击由外部代理变量作为一组识别但不必单独识别的情况。该检验对单独识别冲击的识别方案具有稳健性，即使冲击未被单独识别也可使用。渐近分析得到了小样本模拟的支持，模拟显示该检验具有良好的性质。对美国小型宏观经济模型中生产率冲击影响的研究说明了这一问题对实证工作的重要性。

articles.title_en: Growing through spinoffs. Corporate governance, entry dynamics, and innovation
articles.title_cn: 通过分拆成长：公司治理、进入动态与创新
articles.abstract_en: New firms are often based on ideas developed within incumbent firms. We study spinoff activities in a growth model with entry and product quality innovation. Spinoffs increase aggregate productivity through product variety expansion and, if created voluntarily by incumbents, boost their return to equity. However, they erode incumbents' market share and, when stemming from conflicts between incumbents and employees, raise incumbents' internal cost of capital. The analysis reveals that a priori investment protection has an ambiguous impact on spinoff activities, depending on whether it focuses on incumbents' product quality investments or the creation of voluntary spinoffs. The calibrated model indicates that a broad investment protection reform reduces the spinoff rate but boosts incumbents' product improvement, raising income growth and welfare. The trade-offs are consistent with firm-level evidence from Italy.
articles.abstract_cn: 新企业往往基于在位企业内部发展的理念而创立。我们研究了一个包含进入和产品质量创新的增长模型中的分拆活动。分拆通过产品种类扩张提高了总体生产率，并且如果由在位企业自愿创建，则提升其股权回报。然而，分拆侵蚀了在位企业的市场份额，并且当源于在位企业与员工之间的冲突时，提高了在位企业的内部资本成本。分析表明，事前投资保护对分拆活动的影响是模糊的，取决于其侧重于在位企业的产品质量投资还是自愿分拆的创建。校准模型表明，广泛的投资保护改革降低了分拆率，但促进了在位企业的产品改进，从而提高了收入增长和福利。这些权衡与来自意大利的企业层面证据一致。

articles.title_en: Uncertainty over uncertainty in environmental policy adoption: Bayesian learning of unpredictable socioeconomic costs
articles.title_cn: 环境政策采纳中不确定性的不确定性：对不可预测社会经济成本的贝叶斯学习
articles.abstract_en: The socioeconomic impact of pollution naturally comes with uncertainty due to, e.g., current new technological developments in emissions' abatement or demographic changes. On top of that, the trend of the future costs of the environmental damage is unknown: Will global warming dominate or technological advancements prevail? The truth is that we do not know which scenario will be realised and the scientific debate is still open. This paper captures those two layers of uncertainty by developing a real-options-like model in which a decision maker aims at adopting a once-and-for-all costly reduction in the current emissions rate, when the stochastic dynamics of the socioeconomic costs of pollution are subject to Brownian shocks and the drift is an unobservable random variable. By keeping track of the actual evolution of the costs, the decision maker is able to learn the unknown drift and to form a posterior dynamic belief of its true value. The resulting decision maker's timing problem boils down to a truly two-dimensional optimal stopping problem which we address via probabilistic free-boundary methods and a state-space transformation. We completely characterise the solution by showing that the optimal timing for implementing the emissions reduction policy is the first time that the learning process has become “decisive” enough; that is, when it exceeds a time-dependent percentage. This is given in terms of an endogenously determined threshold function, which solves uniquely a nonlinear integral equation. We numerically illustrate our results, discuss the implications of the optimal policy and also perform comparative statics to understand the role of the relevant model's parameters in the optimal policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 污染的社会经济影响自然伴随着不确定性，例如，当前减排技术的新发展或人口变化。此外，环境损害未来成本的趋势是未知的：全球变暖会占主导地位还是技术进步会胜出？事实是我们不知道哪种情景会实现，科学辩论仍然悬而未决。本文通过开发一个类似实物期权的模型来捕捉这两层不确定性，在该模型中，决策者旨在采纳一次性且代价高昂的当前排放率削减，当污染的社会经济成本的随机动态受到布朗冲击且漂移项是不可观测的随机变量时。通过跟踪成本的实际演变，决策者能够学习未知的漂移项，并对其真实值形成后验动态信念。由此产生的决策者时机问题归结为一个真正的二维最优停止问题，我们通过概率自由边界方法和状态空间变换来解决。我们完全刻画了解决方案，表明实施减排政策的最优时机是学习过程变得“足够决定性”的首次时间；也就是说，当它超过一个随时间变化的百分比时。这以内生确定的阈值函数给出，该函数唯一地求解一个非线性积分方程。我们对结果进行数值说明，讨论最优政策的含义，并进行比较静态分析以理解相关模型参数在最优政策中的作用。
